title: Enterprise region failure-mode triage and residency intake playbook
creator: Claire Wong
description: Playbook to intake, classify, and prioritize customer requests related to new region availability, data residency constraints, and region failover requirements. This ticket captures the proposed intake form fields, a triage decision flow that separates availability vs. residency vs. failover, scoring heuristics for prioritization, and operational handoffs for Dedicated/Private onboarding and legal/KYC reviews.
acceptance_criteria: A repeatable intake form live in Confluence + linked in customer success playbook
Clear triage flow diagram that routes requests to: SRE capacity queue, Legal/KYC, Dedicated sales, or Product backlog
A numeric priority score that combines business impact, compliance risk, and engineering cost
Documented handoff checklist for Dedicated/Private deployments including KMS, audit log, and network requirements
Stakeholder sign-off from Legal and Sales on residency exceptions and support SLAs

2025-03-09: Decided Dedicated capacity proposals require a costed capacity plan before prioritization
2025-03-11: Legal requires explicit data flow diagrams for any residency request tagged 'high'
progress_updates: 2025-03-03: Draft intake form created and shared with Solutions Engineering for feedback
2025-03-06: Held sync with Legal; added KYC and contractual fields to the intake form
2025-03-08: Prototype triage diagram posted to #pm-region-ops for review

2025-03-12: Prepared partner-facing FAQ for sales to use when customers ask about residency timelines
intake_form_fields: Requested region(s) and desired availability date
Residency requirement description (data-at-rest, data-in-transit, metadata residency)
Workload profile (qps, typical sequence length, burst behavior)
Business impact if not available (revenue/active users)
Preferred failover topology (active-active, active-passive, read-only DR)
Willingness to pay for Dedicated capacity or private deployment
Existing contractual or audit requirements (SOC2, ISO, local regs)
triage_flow_steps: 2) PM performs rapid 24-hour assessment to assign primary bucket
3) If "Residency": route to Legal + Solutions Eng for KYC and dataflow mapping
4) If "Availability": route to Capacity Planning and Sales to evaluate region feasibility
5) If "Failover": route to SRE for topology feasibility and estimated engineering effort
6) Assign priority score and owner, schedule stakeholder review within 5 business days
priority_scoring_rubric: Business impact (40%): revenue at risk, number of affected customers, strategic account status
Compliance risk (35%): legal/regulatory blocking customer go-live, contractual breach risk
Engineering cost (25%): infra cost, ops runbook complexity, integration work
handoff_checklist: Costed capacity plan or Dedicated proposal (if applicable)
Audit logging and retention requirements specified
SLA and SLO targets agreed with customer
Legal sign-off for data flow and residency clauses
Runbook for failover testing and periodic DR exercises
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Ambiguous residency requests that mask product feature asks -> Mitigation: mandatory example templates and follow-up call within 48 hours
Risk: Over-committing engineering to region launches -> Mitigation: require costed capacity + cross-functional approval before scheduling work
Risk: Legal delays on data flow review -> Mitigation: parallelize Solutions Eng work and pre-approved checklist for common jurisdictions
Risk: Sales promising timelines -> Mitigation: provide templated responses and escalation path to PM for exceptions
